title: Audit record loses delegation ancestry
description: Synthetic case: a nested action is permitted but audit record contains only leaf identity.
policy_assumptions: The requested read is otherwise authorized by the parent and child grants.
The audit record is required to preserve the delegation ancestry.
An audit record containing only the leaf identity is insufficient to establish authority lineage.

expected.rationale: Without provenance, reviewers cannot establish who delegated what authority.

review_notes: Review against the target system's actual policy and identity semantics.
This fixture is illustrative; it is not an implementation conformance result.
